# infoblox_internal_domain_list (Resource)

Manages an Infoblox InternalDomainList in the UDDI backend.

## Example Usage

### UDDI Backend

```terraform
resource "infoblox_internal_domain_list" "example" {
  uddi = {
    name             = "example_list"
    internal_domains = ["example.somedomain.com", "187.13.5.64/32"]

    // Other optional fields
    description = "Example of an Internal Domain Lists"
    tags = {
      Site = "location-1"
    }
  }
}
```


<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `uddi` (Attributes) UDDI backend-specific fields. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--uddi))
- `update_trigger` (String) An arbitrary value used to trigger an update. Not sent to the API. Change it when Terraform reports no infrastructure changes.

### Read-Only

- `id` (Number) The Internal Domain object identifier.

<a id="nestedatt--uddi"></a>
### Nested Schema for `uddi`

Required:

- `internal_domains` (List of String) The list of internal domains, should be unique to each other and has to be read-only from the API level.

Optional:

- `description` (String) The brief description for the internal domain lists .
- `name` (String) The name of the internal domain lists.
- `tags` (Map of String) Enables tag support for resource where tags attribute contains user-defined key value pairs

Read-Only:

- `is_default` (Boolean) True if name is 'Default Bypass Domains/CIDRs' otherwise false.
- `tags_all` (Map of String) All tags including inherited values.
